translations.web: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.
translations.bsb: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
translations.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
translations.asv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then shall he render unto every man according to his deeds.
